[[File:CarboniteEmitter.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A droid-mounted carbonite projector in action]]
A '''carbonite projector''' was a mounted [[Droid/Legends|droid]] utility item that was employed as a weapon. This weapon used a [[Carbon-freezing/Legends|carbonite freezing]] technique to super-cool synthetic compounds hurled at a target. This item was considered unconventional and had not been in widespread use.

==Behind the scenes==
A droid must be at upgrade class 2 to be able to equip this item.
